title: MITRE T1496 Resource Hijacking & Cryptojacking Triage Playbook

steps.activity_name: Validate Anomalous CPU/GPU Spike or Mining Pool DNS Alert
steps.description: Verify Stratum protocol connections, mining pool domains, or rogue EC2/container compute launches.

steps.activity_name: Inspect Mining Binary, Command Line & Persistence Cron/Task
steps.description: Identify xmrig/miner process lineage, wallet address, and scheduled task or container entrypoint.

steps.activity_name: Determine Initial Access Vector & Check Secondary Compromise
steps.description: Trace exposed APIs, leaked cloud keys, or unpatched services used to deploy the miner.

steps.activity_name: Terminate Rogue Workloads, Block Pools & Revoke Exposed Keys
steps.description: Conditional containment to halt billing impact and eradicate persistence.
steps.condition: Triggered when preliminary investigation indicators confirm active compromise or operational impact.

steps.activity_name: Confirm Resource Baseline Recovery & Close Incident
steps.description: Document cloud/host utilization recovery and hardened access controls.
